title: 10 Best Andrographis Paniculat Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Andrographis paniculat are teas, decoctions, capsules, tinctures, and syrups, each offering unique benefits for traditional and modern herbal medicine. Teas and decoctions are commonly used to harness its bitter properties, believed to support immune function and reduce inflammation. Capsules provide a convenient and standardized form for daily supplementation. Tinctures offer a concentrated dose, often used for acute symptoms. Syrups are popular for their ease of consumption, especially among children and the elderly.
